parsed.summary: The PR addresses the issue of `lambdify` not working with certain `MatrixSymbol` names containing curly braces, even with `dummify=True`. The change is minimal and focused on the problem area.

issues.description: The PR does not include any new tests to verify the fix. It is important to ensure that the change does not regress in the future.
